notes.title: [Official Release for Japanese & English Versions!!!!!!]
notes.content: [h1]Japanese & English Versions is Coming RIGHT NOW!!!!![/h1][p]After incredible localization and QA testing efforts by Amo-sensei, the multi-language version of "Endless Black Song" is finally ready to meet everyone. We are grateful for your patient waiting![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]The languages officially released at this time are [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]English[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If you are launching the game for the first time, a "Select Language" option will be displayed on the screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668458/a7b125a9c38e47a1044b1dd910876bfcc1deb9f6.png"][/img][/p][p]If you have played the game before, you can change the language in the [b]"Config & Languages"[/b] option on the [b]Title Screen[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668458/e6998ec472d0aabb540e1888b9702d839a028aa7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]If you encounter any other issues, please feel free to provide feedback via email or QQ.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: (August 24th Patch) macOS Version Update + Additional Gallery Dialogues
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668458/67fbef893bb6d60538886868ffae776d78df1264.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Gratefulness[/h1][list][*][p]The game's library count has exceeded 15,000! Thank you all for your support and love!![/p][/*][*][p]Multi-language versions are in full swing and are expected to be released within the next week~[/p][/*][*][p][b]【Important】[/b] The game has been released for a week~ If you want to upload gameplay videos on video platforms, please [b]be sure[/b] to state the [b]source of the game[/b] in the [b]description[/b]![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Update Announcement[/h1][list][*][p]The macOS version of the game has been upgraded to nw.js version 0.82, which supports newer macOS versions and greatly improves the stability of the game process.[/p][/*][*][p]Added creator dialogues in the gallery, with more creators elaborating on the plot content and creative process.[/p][/*][*][p]Made more error prevention measures for some map logic to try and solve the black screen issue during exploration on some devices.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: August 19th Bug Fix Patch~
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where closing certain menus would affect the dialogue progression.

- Fixed a bug where saving and then reloading the game in certain situations would cause an error.

(Please be patient as we continue to work on the macOS architectural update and the multi-language version. We've made significant progress!)

notes.title: 8月17日首日Bug修复补丁第1弹~
notes.content:
- 修复了存读档后，游戏中的部分选择和进程不正常的问题
- 修复了画廊与角色对话内容不正确的问题
- 修复了某些情况下教学图无法消失的问题
- 修正了某些情况下的立绘位置错误的问题
- （由于无法复现，其余部分常见的立绘卡住问题，先增加了防错机制）
